data.title: 红莲 · 竹海长风的浪人羽织独步
data.description: 狂风掠过无边无际的翠绿竹海，竹叶如雨般在长风中沙沙作响。红莲身披宽大的黑白浪人羽织，单手握住腰间刀柄，另一只手按住被风掀起的宽大笠帽。白发与羽织在强风中烈烈飞扬，剑客回眸而视，目光如寒星般明彻，随后嘴角扬起一抹只为你而驻足的豪迈深情。
data.action: standing in windy bamboo grove, loose ronin haori billowing, holding katana hilt, wind whipping white ponytail, striking fierce yet devoted glance at viewer
data.location: dense emerald bamboo forest path with swirling green leaves
data.lighting: dramatic shafts of afternoon sunlight piercing emerald bamboo canopies
data.mood: epic wuxia wanderer romance, wild untamed majesty
data.promptProse: Standing in a wind-swept bamboo grove with swirling leaves, Scarlet wears a billowing ronin haori over casual attire. Her white hair streams in the gale as she rests a hand on her sword, smiling with fierce affection.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet standing in a windy bamboo grove with her haori billowing, smiling fiercely.
